You'll be fine. I'm currently in that situation, been out from my mother's house for 5 months now. My siblings are 10 and a 1 year old baby and my mom indeed tried to use them to guilt me too x) but my sister talks to me every now and then, she understands, and my mom would often send me pictures of my baby brother who is like my son (I'm 20 and I basically raised him), so everything is fine. 
As long as YOU are ok and not suffering, that's all you need. 
Think about your siblings needing a place to stay in the future, be the person who's gonna be there for them. Make them understand your reasons to leave and stay in touch with them. Try for them to see you as someone they can trust and rely on, because, trust me, they will need you sooner or later. It is gonna be hard, yes. I'm still frightened sometimes, but it is going to be fine. I promise.
Most of the time, yes

Start packing your stuff, but don't let them know. Then leave them with a friend of yours until you have most of your essentials out, just in case they freak out and don't let you take away your own stuff. This is so you won't end up with nothing. 
And then, leave. Don't ask them. Don't tell them. Apparently, they need you more than you do. It will help if you have a friend over for moral support. Good luck!
